title: Kabangutsi standard message
description: Channel-agnostic message format. Every adapter (app, USSD, SMS, WhatsApp) converts its channel to an InboundMessage and posts it to the backend (POST /v1/channels/{channel}/inbound). The backend answers with an OutgoingReply. All data in examples is fictional.

Lang.description: fr = French, en = English, rn = Kirundi.

Channel.description: phone = simulated voice call in the app; web = text chat in the app (web or Android); ussd = USSD simulator; sms = GSM modem; whatsapp = WhatsApp bridge.

LocalizedText.description: The same text in the three languages. All three are required.

url.description: Where the backend (or adapter) can fetch the file. Files stored by the backend use the relative form /v1/files/{id}. Never a public internet URL at runtime.

name.description: Optional file name shown to users.

InboundMessage.title: InboundMessage
InboundMessage.description: One customer turn from any channel.

phone.description: Caller phone. Null only for anonymous web chat.

session_id.description: Adapter-side session key. Web/phone: the conversation id. USSD: the USSD session id from the simulator. SMS/WhatsApp: the phone number (the backend reuses an open conversation for that phone, or opens one).

lang.description: Language hint from the channel (UI language, previous turn, USSD menu choice). Null = unknown; the backend detects it.

text.description: Message text. Empty string allowed when the turn is only an attachment. For USSD it is the raw menu input (e.g. "2", or "" for the initial *123# dial).

examples.text: Voici ma carte d'identité pour la demande de prêt

Action.description: Something the backend did in code during this turn (never decided by the LLM).

reference.description: Reference read back to the caller: card block reference (BLK-YYYY-NNNNN) or ticket number (TCK-YYYY-NNNNN).

data.description: Action-specific data (e.g. loan simulation result, ticket id). Never contains a PIN or date of birth.

OutgoingReply.title: OutgoingReply
OutgoingReply.description: The backend's answer to one InboundMessage (or a message pushed later, e.g. by a human agent).

in_reply_to.description: Id of the InboundMessage answered. Null for messages pushed later (agent replies).

text.description: Full reply (2–3 sentences for voice). For USSD: the menu screen text.

short_text.description: SMS-safe version, at most 160 characters. Always present.

intent.description: Intent detected for the customer turn (see intent.schema.json). Null for pushed messages.

attachments.description: Files to show or send: PDFs (loan simulation, ticket receipt), TTS audio of the reply when voice was requested.

expected_input.description: What the orchestrator waits for next. UIs mask the field when pin; adapters never log a turn answering pin or date_of_birth.

handoff.description: True when the conversation was put in the human agent queue.

end_session.description: True when the session is over (USSD: END screen; phone: hang up).

model_used.description: Ollama model that produced the reply. Null when no LLM was used (template, USSD menu, agent message).

model_notice.description: Text shown when the router switched model or used a non-LLM path (F20/F21), in the reply language.
examples: Switched to gemma4:e4b: gemma:2b cannot read images.
